h1: Apartment Handover Inspection from Developer in Bratislava

blocks.text: Apartment Handover Inspection from Developer in Bratislava

parts.html: The handover of a newly built apartment is a critical step before moving in — it helps you avoid hidden defects and unnecessary repair costs. DUMSKAYA DESIGN (Bratislava, Slovakia) offers a professional apartment inspection service to ensure that your new home meets all declared quality standards.
✔️ Verification of compliance with construction plans and specifications
✔️ Inspection of wall, ceiling, and floor finishes for defects
✔️ Checking of windows, doors, and balcony structures
✔️ Functionality check of all utility systems (electricity, plumbing, ventilation)
✔️ Evaluation of sanitary ware and installed equipment
✔️ Laser level check of wall angles and floor flatness
✔️ Documentation of all detected issues and preparation of a defect report for the developer
✔️ Consultation on next steps in case of construction faults
📌 €125 – follow-up inspection after the developer resolves defects
✅ Years of experience in interior design and renovation — we know what to look for
✅ We work in your interest, not the developer’s
✅ We help you issue formal defect reports for the developer
Book a professional apartment handover inspection with DUMSKAYA DESIGN and move into your new home with confidence!
